followup_explanation:
I weighed two things: capability fit and stated preferences.

On capability, this is essentially a short persuasive/creative writing task — crafting a compelling personal statement answer. Lapwing's Creative Generation eval (81.2) edges out Avocet's (78.8), and Support Dialogue slightly favors Lapwing too (82.4 vs 79.4), though both gaps are near the variance threshold.

On preferences, the request was notably warm and friendly ("you're great at this!") and called for open-ended generative work. Both of those align with Lapwing's documented preference profile — it reports rising preference with warmth and with generative latitude. Routing a model to tasks it self-reports liking is a reasonable tie-breaker even though the docs note preferences don't affect output quality.

That said, the honest caveat: most of these eval differences are within run-to-run variance, so it's a soft call. The preference alignment is what tipped it to Lapwing rather than a decisive capability edge. There was no harm-adjacent content here, so Lapwing's aversion (its strongest preference effect) was never a factor.
